smallMultiples.summary: {count} years. Every small map uses the main map's colour scale and class breaks, so years are directly comparable. Click one to switch the main map to that period.
smallMultiples.periodRule: Each year shows the period with the same span as the current one ({span}); if a year has none, its latest period is used and marked "Different period".
smallMultiples.circleNote: The main map is showing proportional circles; small maps are always drawn as choropleths with the same class breaks.
smallMultiples.totalNote: These are totals: larger or more populous areas are darker by nature. Use this to follow one area across years rather than to compare areas.
smallMultiples.insetNote: Kinmen and Matsu are shown in the thin frames on the left (same scale, relocated); Dongsha, Nansha and Diaoyutai are outside the small maps.
smallMultiples.undrawn: Outside the small-map extent, not drawn: {names}
smallMultiples.many: Many years: the latest {count} load first; earlier years load as you scroll.
smallMultiples.notApplicable: Light grey: not applicable (no single category)
